localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
There are 12 individual sites within the Group Camp. RV parking is allowed in the group camp. However, there are no electric, water or sewer hookups available. Extra Vehicle fees apply over 12 vehicles. Non-camping day-use visitors must have a Discover Pass.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: S1-Point Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The North shelter has two 8 person picnic tables and a BBQ. Electricity is not available. A vault toilet is located nearby. Alcohol is not allowed.
Any outside vendors that are associated with reservations at the shelters are required to have a Discover Pass to enter the park and are required to provide written proof of insurance to the park at least two weeks prior to the date of the event. Such vendors include but are not limited to caterers, equipment providers, etc. It is the reservation holder’s responsibility to ensure that vendors are in compliance.
All day use shelters must be vacated a half hour before posted closing time. No generators or amplified music without a special activity permit.

localizedValues.name: S2-Beach Parking Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The South shelter has two 8 person picnic tables and a BBQ. Electricity is not available and there is a full comfort station within 150 feet. Alcohol is not allowed.
Any outside vendors that are associated with reservations at the shelters are required to have a Discover Pass to enter the park and are required to provide written proof of insurance to the park at least two weeks prior to the date of the event. Such vendors include but are not limited to caterers, equipment providers, etc. It is the reservation holder’s responsibility to ensure that vendors are in compliance.
All day use shelters must be vacated a half hour before posted closing time. No generators or amplified music without a special activity permit.
